notes.title: VR fighting game
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/565670
It is a first person VR fighting game With KUNLUN FIGHT official authorization, you can train your reaction and boxing technique, and fight against the best martial arts masters in the world.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26829013/e2d7f9a02e6b52a3416635f4c8013fc0a679cc6c.jpg[/img]

Kunlun Fight is a Chinese kickboxing promotion developed by Kunsun Media. Kunlun Fight debuted in 2014 and is regarded as one of the top kickboxing promotions in the world.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26829013/79c583a8669f66e7bddd2facee70ef4536a58d72.jpg[/img]
 
The game is a first person VR fighting game With KUNLUN FIGHT official authorization, in challenge mode, you can fight against the best martial arts masters in the world, such as Buakaw Banchamek, who is one of the most successful and famous 70 kg kickboxers in history, 2 time K-1 World Max Champion，and all kinds of martial arts styles will be included, you may meet Sanda, taekwondo, Jeet Kune Do, and so on. In training mode, you can train your reaction and boxing technique. The game has global leaderboards.


WARNING: For your safety, please free up enough space to play this game, it is recommended that the size of the game space for 4x4 meters, can get the best gaming experience.

notes.title: The Fastest Fist V1.1.1
notes.content:
The Fastest Fist V1.1.1 

After updated V1.1.0, we found there is something wrong with the Global Leaderboards, some player's record changed into 8888 and uploaded to the Leaderboards, we are very sorry about that.

We have solved the problem as soon as possible, also fixed some other bugs, we suggest you re-download and install the latest version to get the best experience.

Please feel free to leave feedback on the Steam community forum, as a comment on this news post, or by emailing us at support@gameart.cn, Thank you!


快拳 V1.1.1 

上次更新版本后，排行榜出现了一些问题，有些玩家的纪录变成了8888并上传到了全球排行榜上，我们对出现这种错误深表歉意！
我们已经尽快解决了这个问题，还修复了其他一些bug，强烈建议大家重新下载并安装最新版本！
欢迎继续在论坛和本新闻下面留言，提供您宝贵的意见和建议！也可以发邮件到support@gameart.cn ，非常感谢！

notes.title: The Fastest Fist V1.1.0
notes.content:
快拳1.1.0

非常感谢大家对我们游戏的支持，你们的评测和建议对我们很重要，我们会继续完善和改进游戏，欢迎继续提供您宝贵的意见和建议！support@gameart.cn

1.1.0

更新列表：
- 新增10个关卡
- 修复排行榜数据，只提交最好成绩
- 增加了restart和exit按钮，可以在游戏中和游戏结束后返回logo界面重新开始和关闭游戏。
- UI改进：更改了按钮的样式和统计界面、排行榜界面


预告：
我们正在制作一款第一人称VR格斗游戏，将于2016年圣诞节前发布，敬请期待！


The Fastest Fist V1.1.0

Thank for your support! Your reviews and suggestions are very important to us, we'll continue to finish and improve this game, please feel free to leave feedback on the Steam community forum, as a comment on this news post, or by emailing us at support@gameart.cn.

PS: We are working on a new first-person boxing game, of course it is designed for VR, and it'll be published before christmas this year!

Changelog:
- add 10 new levels
- fixed the bug of leaderboard, only the highest score should be displayed in the Leaderboards.
- add RESTART and EXIT buttons, player now could restart and exit from the game
- UI changes: changed the appearance of buttons, Statistics panel and Leaderboards
